text.en:
Section 270 of the National Internal Revenue Code of 1977, as amended, is further amended to
read as follows:
"Sec. 270. Measuring of forest products and invoicing and collection of charges thereon. The duties incident
to the measuring of forest products shall be discharged by the Bureau of Forest Development under
regulations of the Ministry of Natural Resources. The invoicing and collection of the charges thereon shall be
done by the Bureau of Internal Revenue under regulations approved by the Minister of Finance."
